name: Scanlix
author: scanlix

sections.description:
Scanlix helps you make your WordPress site accessible to everyone. It scans your pages for WCAG 2.2 Level A, AA, and AAA violations using real browser rendering—not just static HTML analysis—so you catch issues that matter to real users, including screen reader compatibility and keyboard navigation.

AI-Powered Fix Generation

When Scanlix finds an issue, it doesn’t just tell you what’s wrong—it suggests how to fix it. Using AI providers (Groq, Google Gemini, or OpenAI), the plugin generates concrete, ready-to-apply fixes. Review each suggestion in a clear diff view, then apply it with one click. If something doesn’t look right, roll back instantly.

Compliance Dashboard

Track your accessibility progress over time with a dashboard that shows scores, trends, and issue counts by severity. Filter issues by WCAG criterion, page, or impact level. Perfect for agencies managing multiple sites or teams working toward compliance deadlines.

Works Everywhere

Scanlix works with any WordPress theme and popular page builders including Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Beaver Builder, and more. No theme lock-in. Multi-site support lets agencies manage licenses across client sites from a single account.

Compliance Badge

Display a compliance badge on your site to show visitors you care about accessibility. Customize its placement and style to match your brand.

Pricing

A free plan is available with 5 pages per month and 3 AI fixes per month—enough to get started and evaluate the plugin. Premium plans start at $19/year (Lite) or $39/month (Starter) for more pages, AI fixes, and multi-site support.

Standards Coverage

Scanlix helps you meet ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act), Section 508, EN 301 549, and European Accessibility Act requirements. WCAG 2.2 AA is the foundation for all of these standards.

External Services

Scan processing and fix generation happen on Scanlix cloud servers (api.scanlix.app). Your site sends page URLs and HTML snippets for analysis; no personal data is transmitted. See the External Services section below for full details.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

1. Scanlix API (api.scanlix.app)
* Purpose: Scan processing, license validation, fix generation coordination
* Data sent:
– License key (for validation)
– Site URL and page URLs to scan
– HTML content of scanned pages
– Issue detection results
* When: When you click “Scan Now” or “Generate Fix”
* Privacy Policy: https://scanlix.app/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://scanlix.app/terms

2. AI Providers (via Scanlix API)
* Providers: Groq (groq.com), Google Gemini (ai.google.dev), OpenAI (openai.com)
* Purpose: AI-powered fix generation for accessibility issues
* Data sent: HTML snippets related to the specific issue (PII-scrubbed)
* When: Only when you click “Generate Fix” for a specific issue
* Data Retention: AI providers may retain data for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring unless a zero-data-retention agreement is in place
* Note: We strip personal data from HTML before processing, but page content may incidentally contain author names or email addresses in HTML attributes or text

All external service connections are encrypted (HTTPS). For detailed information on data processing, see our Privacy Policy at https://scanlix.app/privacy.

Disclaimer and Limitation of Liability

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK

Scanlix is provided “AS IS” without warranty of any kind, express or implied. Akaya Ltd (trading as Scanlix) makes NO WARRANTIES regarding:

  • Accuracy of scan results
  • Safety of AI-generated fixes
  • Compatibility with your theme, plugins, or hosting environment
  • Freedom from errors or downtime
  • Suitability for compliance with ADA, Section 508, WCAG, or any accessibility law

IMPORTANT – Fixes May Break Your Site:

  • AI-generated fixes are suggestions, not guarantees
  • Always test fixes on a staging site before applying to production
  • Use the one-click rollback feature if a fix causes issues
  • Scanlix cannot guarantee rollback will restore perfect functionality
  • Some fixes may conflict with your theme, plugins, or custom code

LIABILITY CAP:

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Akaya Ltd’s total liability for any claim arising from your use of Scanlix shall not exceed £100 (one hundred pounds sterling). This includes but is not limited to: site downtime, data loss, incorrect fixes, failed rollbacks, or any consequential damages.

Scanlix assists with accessibility compliance but does NOT guarantee immunity from lawsuits or regulatory fines. You remain solely responsible for your website’s legal compliance. Consult an accessibility attorney for legal advice.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the Scanlix plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through Plugins → Add New and search for “Scanlix”.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Scanlix in the admin menu.
  4. Enter your license key. Get a free key at scanlix.app.
  5. Click Scan Now to run your first accessibility scan.
sections.faq:
What WCAG standards are checked?

Scanlix checks WCAG 2.2 Level A, AA, and AAA success criteria. You can filter scans by level (e.g., AA only for most compliance requirements) and view results by criterion.

Does it slow down my site?

No. Scanning runs on Scanlix cloud servers, not on your WordPress server. Your site’s performance is unaffected. The plugin adds minimal front-end code; the compliance badge (if enabled) is lightweight.

What themes does it support?

Scanlix works with any WordPress theme and popular page builders including Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Beaver Builder, and others. Scans use real browser rendering, so dynamic content is fully analyzed.

How does auto-fix work?

When an issue is found, Scanlix sends the relevant HTML snippet to an AI provider (Groq, Google Gemini, or OpenAI) to generate a fix. You see a before/after diff, approve the change, and it’s applied to your content. You can roll back any fix instantly.

Is my data secure?

Only HTML snippets related to the reported issue are sent for fix generation. No personal data, user accounts, or sensitive content is transmitted. Scan processing happens on Scanlix servers with industry-standard security practices.

What’s included in the free plan?

The free plan includes 5 pages per month and 3 AI-generated fixes per month. You get full access to the dashboard, issue list, and compliance badge. Upgrade for more pages and unlimited fixes.

How do I upgrade?

Visit scanlix.app to choose a premium plan. Enter your new license key in Scanlix → Settings to activate the upgrade.

What happens if a fix breaks something?

Every fix can be rolled back with one click. Scanlix keeps a history of applied fixes so you can revert to the previous version at any time. We recommend reviewing each AI suggestion before applying.
